spec.headline: Paid Media Strategy | AI-Assisted Marketing Systems | B2B Growth
spec.headline_rationale: The role needs building operating systems, paid media, AI oversight, reporting and cross-functional alignment. Use source-supported multi-company PPC transformation and evidence-bound AI marketing tools without inventing autonomous fleets, ABM pipeline or infrastructure vertical expertise.
spec.summary: Paid media strategist who builds repeatable marketing operations as well as campaigns. Created an in-house PPC structure for 32 businesses, consolidating agency work, developing the team and integrating with ERP systems. Built automated cross-channel reporting and an AI-assisted marketing command center that turns verified advertising and website data into audits, recommendations and reporting. Combines B2B cross-functional leadership, acquisition testing and investment analysis to improve execution quality and keep spending decisions connected to commercial priorities.
spec.factual_review: Read exact Jobgether Senior Demand Generation Manager Paid Media posting. Master Any Hour and marketing command center projects support system claims; E009/E060/E002/E006/E010/E076/E081 support remaining emphasis. No claim of autonomous spending agents, cloud/telecom SaaS tenure, creator sponsorship ownership or formal ABM results.
spec.tools_rationale: Master-supported paid media, CRM, analytical and AI tooling relevant to building accountable marketing systems.
